---
title: "usetdm"
subtitle: "Stata command to download example data for classes, workshops, and replication files"
---

`usetdm` loads datasets from the web to recreate the examples from various
classes and workshops, and the replication files from various projects. The
datasets live in the `data/` folder of the
[tdmize/data](https://github.com/tdmize/data) GitHub repository; `usetdm`
saves typing the address. Every dataset on this page can also be opened
without installing anything:

```stata
use "https://tdmize.github.io/data/data/gss", clear
```

## Installation

```stata
net install usetdm, from("https://tdmize.github.io/data") replace
```

## Use

```stata
usetdm dataname [, clear]
```

Option `clear` must be specified if another dataset is currently in memory.

```{.stata-run}
. usetdm gss, clear
Loading dataset...
(gss.dta | GSS 1972 - 2016 Data | DMV Workshop)

. describe, short

Contains data from https://tdmize.github.io/data/data/gss.dta
 Observations:        62,466                  gss.dta | GSS 1972 - 2016 Data | DMV Workshop
    Variables:           113                  24 Mar 2018 14:28
Sorted by: 

```

## Available datasets

The table lists every dataset in the folder as of September 2026, with the
number of observations and variables. The folder itself is at
[tdmize.github.io/data/data](https://tdmize.github.io/data/data.html), and
the class and workshop materials that use these files are on the
[Teaching](https://www.trentonmize.com/teaching) pages. Datasets marked
"si" are prepared for the Methodology Center's Summer Institute on Longitudinal Data
Analysis; "CDA" is for my Categorical Data Analysis.
